privileged.modules/buyer-invoices/store.ts: The buyer invoices API: a request names no org, so its linv_ key is looked up org-less by prefix and compared by hash in constant time; every later read and write (keys, links, invoicing sales and documents) is pinned to that key's org and issuer profile in SQL, and which sales a buyer sees is decided by the matching rule.
privileged.modules/buyer-invoices/file.ts: Streams the one PDF a live download link names: reads that file row's storage key in the link's org, never a sealed file, and lets no storage key or URL out.
privileged.modules/buyer-invoices/routes.ts: Writes the audit row of a buyer API call (list, link, download) in the key's org; no read.
privileged.modules/buyer-invoices/admin-routes.ts: Writes the audit row of a website access key's creation or revocation in the admin's own org; no read.
